home.title: Ship GitHub Releases everywhere in one step.
home.subtitle: Configure Modrinth, Hangar, and CurseForge targets once on the web. Run comet locally or in CI to publish your latest release with loaders, versions, and dependencies intact.
home.howSubtitle: Stop copy-pasting changelogs, picking 12 Minecraft versions, and re-uploading JARs across dashboards.
home.step1Desc: Your existing workflow compiles your plugin or mod and attaches the artifact to a GitHub Release.
home.step2Desc: Link personal or organization projects on Modrinth, Hangar, and CurseForge with encrypted API tokens and saved dependencies.
home.step3Desc: Run the interactive Rust CLI in your terminal or trigger headless publishing inside GitHub Actions.
home.ciSubtitle: Automate every release tag with a single step using your personal Comet CLI token.
home.platformsSubtitle: One source of truth for release artifacts, changelogs, and platform metadata.
home.platform1Desc: Public and private repositories, organization repos, automatic latest release and artifact pattern matching.
home.platform2Desc: Personal and organization projects, all plugin and mod loaders, Minecraft versions down to 1.20, and dependencies.
home.platform3Desc: Paper, Velocity, and Waterfall releases with channel selection, dependency sync, and JWT authentication.
home.ctaBannerTitle: Ready to stop uploading releases by hand?
home.ctaBannerSubtitle: Connect your GitHub repository in under a minute and ship your next build with comet.
home.footerDesc: Free and open-source release publishing for GitHub Releases, Modrinth, Hangar, and CurseForge.

pricing.title: Free now, and for a long time.
pricing.subtitle: Every feature in Comet is completely free to use today with no credit card or artificial limits. That could change down the road — if Comet saves you time, supporting us on GitHub helps keep it free.
pricing.planDesc: No locked features, no seat limits, and no trial countdowns. Full access to the web dashboard, Rust CLI, and GitHub Actions.
pricing.supportSubtitle: Hosting, maintenance, and new platform integrations take time. If you want to back the project, you can support us directly on GitHub.
pricing.supportWay1Desc: Help cover infrastructure costs and ongoing development.
pricing.supportWay2Desc: Help other Minecraft and open-source maintainers find Comet.
pricing.supportWay3Desc: Open issues, suggest new targets, or submit pull requests.
pricing.faq1Title: Will this change in the future?
pricing.faq1Desc: Comet is completely free today and intended to stay that way for a long time. If hosting costs grow later, paid tiers for larger teams may be introduced with plenty of advance notice.
pricing.faq2Desc: Yes. Both the Rust CLI and the web dashboard are AGPL-3.0 licensed, so you can inspect the code, contribute, or self-host your own instance anytime.
pricing.faq3Desc: Sponsorships and stars keep the project independent and actively maintained without ads, paywalled basics, or tracking.

changelog.title: Changelog
changelog.subtitle: Release notes for the Comet Rust CLI and web dashboard.
changelog.emptyFilter: No releases match this filter yet.
changelog.w5Summary: Comet Web v0.4.1 refines the mobile dashboard layout, project tab scrolling, and responsive spacing.
changelog.w5Feat1Desc: Balanced 2-column action buttons, cleaner GitHub account and quick-start cards, and wrapped target badges on narrow screens.
changelog.w5Feat2Desc: Targets, Releases, History, and Settings tabs now scroll smoothly on small viewports without wrapping awkwardly.
changelog.c5Summary: Comet CLI v0.4.1 replaces the tall action menu with a direct command prompt and gracefully handles expired GitHub tokens.
changelog.c5Feat1Desc: Type commands directly at the comet prompt (publish, dry-run, targets, init, status, doctor, account, logout, help, exit) instead of scrolling a long list.
changelog.c5Feat2Desc: If a stored GitHub token is expired, Comet automatically retries public repositories unauthenticated and displays a clear reconnect hint for private repos.
changelog.w4Summary: Comet Web v0.4.0 brings full CurseForge target configuration, CLI project initialization, and updated open-source links.
changelog.w4Feat1Desc: Configure CurseForge numeric project IDs, Upload API tokens, plugin/mod loaders, game versions, and dependencies alongside Modrinth and Hangar.
changelog.w4Feat2Desc: Added POST /api/cli/projects for instant repository registration from the terminal and unified all outbound API headers to the workspace version.
changelog.c4Title: CurseForge Publisher, comet init & comet doctor
changelog.c4Summary: Comet CLI v0.4.0 adds CurseForge uploads, repository auto-detection, diagnostics, and hardened HTTP/config handling.
changelog.c4Feat1Desc: Publish directly to CurseForge with Java Minecraft version-type filtering, register repos with comet init, and verify setup with comet doctor.
changelog.c4Feat2Desc: Added 15s connect / 120s transfer HTTP timeouts, 0600 Unix config permissions, empty release title fallbacks, and local Git repo pre-selection.
changelog.w3Title: Faster rendering, hardened APIs & cleaner UI
changelog.w3Summary: Comet Web v0.3.0 pauses off-screen WebGL shaders, parallelizes project database queries, and hardens all API routes.
changelog.w3Feat1Desc: WebGL backgrounds and the interactive star wordmark now pause automatically when scrolled out of view or in background tabs, while project targets and history load in parallel.
changelog.w3Feat2Desc: Added strict UUID and JSON body validation across all endpoints, duplicate repository protection, and stale-request guards in the repository import modal.
changelog.c3Title: Faster startup, TOML config & modular publish flow
changelog.c3Summary: Comet CLI v0.3.0 moves config to ~/.comet/config.toml, removes custom endpoint prompts, and parallelizes workspace startup.
changelog.c3Feat1Desc: Stores your CLI token cleanly in ~/.comet/config.toml and connects directly to comet.fraio.cc without extra endpoint prompts.
changelog.c3Feat2Desc: Runs account verification and workspace project queries concurrently via tokio::join! and splits the publish pipeline into focused submodules.
changelog.w2Summary: Comet Web v0.2.0 adds a live Publish History tab to every project and automatic Discord release notifications.
changelog.w2Feat1Desc: Every CLI and GitHub Actions publish is recorded with its release tag, artifact name, source badge, and direct links to published Modrinth and Hangar versions.
changelog.w2Feat2Desc: Configure an optional Discord webhook per project with one-click test delivery to announce new releases automatically.
changelog.c2Summary: Comet CLI v0.2.0 introduces silent startup auto-updates, automatic publish history reporting, and a faster GitHub Marketplace Action.
changelog.c2Feat1Desc: Checks GitHub Releases on launch with a short timeout and seamlessly updates Windows and Linux binaries without interrupting your workflow.
changelog.c2Feat2Desc: Automatically reports completed publishes back to your Comet workspace and triggers configured Discord webhooks.
changelog.c1Summary: First release of the Comet CLI and GitHub Actions workflow for publishing GitHub Releases to Modrinth and Hangar in one step.
changelog.c1Feat1Desc: Auto-detects your Git repository, lets you toggle targets, pick changelog sources (GitHub Release notes, full commit messages, or custom input), and preview uploads with --dry-run.
changelog.c1Feat2Desc: Supports private GitHub Release assets, preserves Hangar externalUrl dependencies with interactive retry prompts, and runs headless in CI using personal CLI tokens.
changelog.w1Summary: First release of the Comet web dashboard for connecting GitHub repositories, managing Modrinth and Hangar targets, and issuing personal CLI tokens.
changelog.w1Feat1Desc: Store Modrinth and Hangar tokens with AES-256-GCM encryption, auto-list personal and organization projects, and sync loaders, game versions, and dependencies.
changelog.w1Feat2Desc: Sign in with GitHub or email/password, inspect repository releases directly in the workspace, generate SHA-256 hashed CLI tokens, and install via PowerShell, CMD, or shell.

download.title: Install Comet CLI
download.subtitle: One binary built in Rust. Authenticate once with a personal CLI token and publish releases straight from your terminal.
download.psHint: Downloads the latest Windows binary to %LOCALAPPDATA%\comet\bin and adds it to your user PATH.
download.cmdHint: Works directly in Windows Command Prompt via built-in PowerShell invocation.
download.unixHint: Installs the matching x86_64 or arm64 binary to ~/.local/bin/comet.
download.cargoHint: Build directly from source using the Rust toolchain (Rust 1.85+).
download.step1Desc: Open a new terminal and confirm comet is on your PATH.
download.step2Title: Sign in with a CLI token
download.step2Desc: Generate a personal token in your Dashboard and save it locally.
download.step3Desc: Run comet inside any configured GitHub repository folder.
